sections.heading: Available
sections.text: Current maintenance arrangement C and superseded arrangement A are available. Requests for video, hydraulic measurements and bench records receive separate availability responses from the record custodian.

sections.heading: Unavailable
sections.text: The incident keeper interface is not visible in another camera. No measured lateral offset at release or approved dynamic keeper-envelope analysis can be supplied from the retained records. No record establishes the contamination onset.

sections.heading: Reopening conditions
sections.text: A newly validated envelope calculation plus a bounded incident offset could reopen the keeper branch. A traceable earlier contamination sample or dated inspection could reopen origin timing. This response establishes availability only; missing records are not physical causes.
